text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position in opening and conclusion","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite argument early and reinforces the same position at the end, so the reader always knows where it stands."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on intoxicated drivers, reckless drivers, and pedestrians","quality":"organizational development","description":"It develops the argument in a more extended, structured way with separate points that build on one another."},{"evidence":"explains how driverless cars could help intoxicated drivers reach destinations safely","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"It goes beyond naming benefits by explaining how the technology would address a specific danger."},{"evidence":"connects road rage and unsafe driving to accidents and injuries","quality":"explanatory support","description":"It uses cause-and-effect explanation to show why its claims matter rather than just asserting them."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like 'Another issue' and 'By resolving issues'","quality":"cohesion","description":"Its ideas are linked with clearer transitions that make the essay easier to follow."}]}
